_comment: Open Portal (plan-portal-spells.md C1, D1/D7/D10): a wind-up cast that leaves a doorway standing next to the caster for 30 s, and anyone who presses E on it and takes the row is delivered to the CASTER's bound campfire. Its niche is moving OTHER players (§1): personal travel home already ships free as the Recall utility, so this is priced as group transport rather than personal escape. SHAPE IS WIND-UP PLUS TTL, NOT A CHANNEL (D1, PO ruling 2026-08-17): cast state rides own-player-only wire fields, so 'open while channeling' and 'open for 30 s' are indistinguishable to every player but the caster, and no sustain or cancel hook exists to build the channel on. castTicks 75 (2.5 s) with castInterruptedByDamage true is Recall's posture and buys the whole interrupt matrix (movement, damage, other presses, death, unequip) plus cost-charged-only-on-completion for free. ⭐ maxLevel 1 IS THE DELIBERATE SHAPE, not a stub: the closed {1, 5, 10} vocabulary defines 1 as a binary ability with nothing to scale, and names Recall, Revive, Haste and Recover, which is exactly the company this keeps. A portal either stands where you need it or it does not; stretching its TTL or shaving its cooldown by level would price a utility as if it were a build choice, and it would cost the level budget 7 points for the privilege. It also keeps D7 honest with one line of arithmetic: with no ttlTicksPerLevel there is no max-level TTL to chase, so cooldownTicks 1200 comfortably clears cast 75 + TTL 900 = 975 and a second portal cannot coexist with the first. Should a later pass want levels, the slope has to be re-derived on both sides at once, and the cooldown must cover the MAX-level TTL. ⭐ requiresAnchor true is the new opt-in on the spawn effect and is the reason this file exists rather than reusing FireTotem's row: the portal's DESTINATION is the caster's bound campfire, so casting one unbound opens a door to nowhere. The flag refuses the press with the no-anchor reason at the press AND again at cast completion, the recall precedent. It is authored per skill rather than derived from the type because FireTotem fires the same `spawn` effect and must keep working for a character who has never seen a campfire. No unlock source, DELIBERATELY (D10): placement is a later PO call and the skill is SKILL-cheat granted for now, the FireVulnerability convention (a worked example awaiting the content pass, NOT one of the Omni test rigs that must never gain a source). ALL NUMBERS [PLACEHOLDER] per the GDD rule; the cost in particular is a first guess an order of magnitude above FireTotem's 0.02 because it moves a group rather than a totem, and §10 item 13 is where the PO prices it after two-window play.
name: OpenPortal
